_comment: Copy this file to auth-config.json and fill in the three values. auth-config.json is gitignored. See _Documentation/MSAL-app-registration.md for one-time setup.
_scope_note: Workspace.Read.All is required for the in-page Setup picker (lists workspaces/reports). If you only need to embed a pre-configured PBIReport.json, Report.Read.All alone is sufficient.
_optional_redirectUri: Leave unset to use the page's own origin (recommended for local file:// or http://localhost). Override only if your app registration requires a specific value.
